headline: Thought: The slow-handler test sleeps past the ack timeout, so the broker closes the channel
details: The slow-handler test sleeps past the ack timeout, so the broker closes the channel before basic_ack runs. Long work should not block the ack window: move processing to a worker thread and ack via add_callback_threadsafe, or lower the work per message.

headline: Agent: The consumer now uses manual acks with prefetch 10. Work runs on a thread pool and acks are scheduled back on the connection thread, so slow orders no longer hit the ack timeout.
details: The consumer now uses manual acks with prefetch 10. Work runs on a thread pool and acks are scheduled back on the connection thread with add_callback_threadsafe, so slow orders no longer hit the broker's delivery acknowledgement timeout. Failed orders are nacked with requeue. All 4 broker tests pass.
